The '''''Blue Boy''''' was a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|720 light freighter]]. Owned and operated by [[Mair Koda]], the ''Blue Boy'' was used to transport goods throughout the [[Zuni cluster]].<ref name="TD" />
